deck_title: Lambert azimuthal equal-area dome projection vs naive orthographic N.xy horizon crush rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Johann Heinrich Lambert (1772) azimuthal equal-area hemisphere projection (p = N_xy / sqrt(1 + N_z), where r^2 = (1 - N_z^2)/(1 + N_z) === 1 - N_z = u, locking solid-angle area Jacobian J = d(r^2)/du = 1.0000x across all 17 stations) versus naive orthographic hemisphere projection (p = N_xy, where r^2 = 2u - u^2 yields J = 2(1 - u) = 2 N_z, bloating zenith texels to 2.0000x and crushing horizon texels to 0.0000x across 16/17 stations) and 64-ring Archimedes spherical-cap quadrature.
